card.name: Partway through names in science news
card.fires_on: Fires on a piece of a proper name or a word partway through it in science news and web text, such as the 'ubble' in Hubble, a surname ending, or a URL piece. A few hits fall on verbs like 'asserted' or 'declared' after a lead-in.

card.writes: It promotes odd name-start pieces and suppresses words like 'known' and 'fact', so it points away from 'well-known fact' phrasing.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of names such as Hubble or an author's surname in science news.
